items.title: Empresa americana é acusada de roubar tecnologia da Samsung, diz jornal
items.pt:
A Samsung investiga um possível vazamento de informações confidenciais de sua linha de produção de semicondutores envolvendo a Lam Research Korea, subsidiária sul-coreana da fabricante americana de equipamentos. De acordo com o jornal The Elec, o caso envolve arquivos com receitas de fabricação de chips.
Esses dados são considerados estratégicos para controlar etapas industriais e preservar a competitividade da divisão de semicondutores, e os documentos teriam sido enviados à empresa em ocasiões

items.title: Rivais de BYD e GWM derretem preços para alavancar vendas de SUVs
items.pt:
A disputa entre as marcas chinesas ganhou mais um capítulo com descontos expressivos para o público PcD. Jetour S06 Advance e GAC GS4 Premium tiveram seus preços jogados no chão, com descontos que ultrapassam R$ 30 mil.
Os dois SUVs são alternativas para quem considera modelos como BYD Song Plus e GWM Haval H6. O Jetour S06 Advance passou de R$ 199.900 para R$ 163.200, enquanto o GAC GS4 Premium caiu de R$ 191.990 para R$ 159.990.

A maior redução é a do modelo da Jetour, com R$ 36.700 de abatim

items.title: The Cold-Start Take-Home: Grade Whether an Agent Survives an Ephemeral Free Server
items.pt:
An agent take-home that only grades the happy path quietly rewards designs that cannot survive a restart, a redeploy, or a suspended container. The cold-start take-home adds exactly one adversarial condition to an otherwise ordinary task: the process is killed at an arbitrary point and must finish correctly after coming back. That single constraint exposes state placement, idempotency, and recovery honesty faster than any code review of the prompt layer.

The reason this belongs in an interview

items.title: Software engineer resume in 2026: how to show the work AI isn't doing
items.pt:
A strong software engineer resume in 2026 shows more than the code you wrote. Most developers now use AI to help write code, so recruiters see the same "built features with React and Node" bullets on every resume. Production skills stand out more: deploying, monitoring and fixing systems that real users depend on.

items.title: Freelance Web Developer Pricing Guide: How to Set Rates That Stick
items.pt:
Setting your rates as a freelance web developer is one of the hardest decisions you'll make in your career. Charge too little, and you'll burn out while barely covering expenses. Charge too much, and you'll price yourself out of the market. The truth? There's no one-size-fits-all answer, but there are proven frameworks that work.


  
  
  Understanding the Three Pricing Models


Most freelance web developers use one of three approaches: hourly rates, project-based pricing, or value-based pricing

items.title: Video-Coder: Reinforcing Agentic Coding for Video Generation
items.pt: Recent years have witnessed remarkable progress in video generation in terms of visual quality and temporal consistency. However, generating videos with precise spatial structure, coherent motion dynamics, and controllable scene composition remains challenging. In this paper, we introduce Video-Coder, the first attempt to train a code-driven video generation agent, which autonomously writes and executes code to construct a dynamic 3D scene (Draft Video) that provides structure and motion signals

items.title: On Agentic Manipulation Policies
items.pt: Recent work on robot manipulation has focused on specialist policies trained on demonstrations. We show that generalist AI models can control manipulators more reliably than specialist policies such as vision-language-action models (VLAs) and world-action models (WAMs). We systematically analyze agentic manipulation policies (AMPs), in which a generalist AI model commands the manipulator directly, adapting its actions as the task unfolds. We present AMP1, a reference harness that runs unchanged
